the proton and the deuteron structure functions F2 are measured in the kinematic range 0.1 < Q2 < 10 GeV2 and 0.003 < x < 0.3, with high precision.

the measurement of deep inelastic scattering of muons on protons and deuterons.
the study of the structure functions of the proton and neutron from deep in-elastic muon scattering.
the structure of hadrons and the dynamics of the strong interactions at high momentum transfer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quark-partons are the constituents of the nucleon.
the data are consistent with QCD and with the quark-partonic picture of the nucleon.
the structure functions of the proton and neutron are in good agreement with the predictions of QCD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our measurements confirm the validity of perturbative QCD and of the quark parton model in the kinematic range of our measurements.
we have shown that QCD is valid for the structure functions Fp and Fn of the nucleons.
we have measured the structure functions of proton and deuteron with a high precision, which is comparable with that of the most recent experiments at SLAC and CERN.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ratio F2n/Fp and its difference F2p -F2n are very sensitive to the structure of the nucleon.
